transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. BCCI's big plan for Sooryavanshi: 'Serve like Sachin, not be a one-year wonder'. The BCCI is diligently tracking 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's development in cricket. With his remarkable debut as India's youngest men's international player following an explosive IPL performance, the board aims to capitalise on his promise for a sustainable international career. They are keen to ensure he avoids being labeled a fleeting talent while closely mentoring a broader pool of young players at the Centre of Excellence. Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sanchez attended an exclusive club event as guests. Six months later, Bezos still awaits membership despite owning island properties. Membership at Indian Creek Country Club requires more than significant financial investment. Other prominent residents also face challenges in securing club membership. Tougher than Everest rescues: Inside Nepal's biggest airlift. Trishuli Bazaar: With roads and bridges severed across Rasuwa and Nuwakot after the Aug 26 Bhote Koshi-Trishuli flood, helicopters became the main rescue lifeline, airlifting more than 4,000 people in hundreds of sorties through a narrow gorge in what officials described as possibly Nepal's biggest such operation. Ohio dam removal reopens 39km of Cuyahoga, 15 fish species return. The removal of the Brecksville Diversion Dam has enhanced river habitats, allowing migrating fish to thrive. Researchers documented the arrival of fifteen new fish species within the lower Cuyahoga River. While native species have successfully reestablished their presence, the advent of nonnative species also marked a significant change in the ecosystem. Ongoing efforts to eliminate more dams aim to further rejuvenate the Cuyahoga River basin for future generations. Bengal to have 1,000 RSS-run schools within a year: Suvendu. KOLKATA: Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari set a target Thursday to establish at least 1,000 schools run by RSS's education wing Vidya Bharati in every district, municipality and panchayat within a year. Lake District river re-bent after 200 years, salmon return in months. Conservationists undertook an inspiring project to restore the natural meanders of Swindale Beck, which had been straightened for centuries. Within just a few months, the restored gravel beds welcomed back the Atlantic salmon to spawn, while also decreasing flood risks and enhancing drinking water quality for millions. This remarkable recovery fostered a thriving habitat for aquatic insects and river birds, ultimately earning the UK River Prize in 2022. Scientists use Burmese pythons as 'living sensors' to reveal hidden wetland pollution. Florida's Burmese pythons are notorious for swallowing native wildlife, but scientists are finding another use for these invasive snakes. Apple and Google rename Lake Ontario to Lake America; one app refuses Trump's order. MapQuest's refusal to comply with a federal directive to rename Lake Ontario has landed the app at the peak of the US App Store charts. Unlike Google Maps and Apple Maps, which followed the presidential order, MapQuest experienced a remarkable boost, collecting over 1.5 million downloads in North America. The company is now shifting focus towards new features that users are eager for. Government to allow retrofit devices for polluting trucks and buses. To Make Old Diesel Vehicles BS

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. PFRDA proposes 10 key changes to PoP rules: What NPS subscribers need to know. The PFRDA has unveiled ten significant proposals aimed at reforming its Points of Presence rules to enhance the pension service landscape. These updates intend to streamline the onboarding process for subscribers while introducing fresh eligibility standards to include a wider range of entities as Points of Presence. Additionally, an annual fee structure will be implemented, and pension agents will receive a new designation. SEBI's new ETF pricing rules from 7 September: What's changing and why investors should care , experts explain. SEBI's new rules from 7 September will change base prices, price bands, pre-open auctions, and close-out procedures for ETFs. Here's what the changes mean for investors, including how they may affect ETF trading, price discovery, and the way investors should trade. EPF versus NPS: rupees 10,000/monthly investment in each; where you may get a higher retirement corpus?. The National Pension System (NPS) and the Employee Provident Fund (EPF) both serve unique purposes for retirement planning. The ultimate financial growth from these investments significantly relies on future market performance, allowing both options to potentially build substantial wealth over time. rupees 1 Crore by 45: How much should you invest in SIPs at age 25 or 35?. Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs) in mutual funds are among the popular routes for creating long-term wealth. Through an SIP, investors put a fixed amount into a mutual fund at regular intervals, generally every month rupees 34.8 lakh difference in price and stamp duty added to husband's income for taxation despite a jointly owned property - ITAT Mumbai calls it 'not justified'. A husband and a wife bought a flat jointly for rupees 60 lakh, however, the stamp duty value stood at rupees 94.8 lakh, leading to a difference of rupees 34.8 lakh. The amont was added to the husband's income alone by the tax office, despite him having a lower ownership in the property. ITAT Mumbai has delivered a ruling which could have significant takeaways for property owners. HDFC Bank fell 26 percent in the last 1 year while SBI gained: Which mutual funds are betting big on the top 5 lenders?. India's top five banks by market capitalisation delivered sharply different returns over the past year. While HDFC Bank fell 26 percent , SBI gained 26 percent , with Axis Bank rising 20 percent . The story looks different when viewed through mutual fund portfolios. Land grabbed by neighbour for 40 years? Karnataka HC rejects adverse possession claim, upholds owner's title. Know how an owner won fight for his 4-acre-11-gunta land in Karnataka HC after neighbour claimed title to this land based on 40 years of adverse possession and revenue records Mutual fund expense ratio gaps: Which diversified and sectoral equity funds cost investors the most , and least?. Mutual fund expense ratios can vary sharply even within the same category. Active funds generally show wider cost spreads than passive funds. Investors should compare costs across peers and assess whether higher expenses are justified by performance. Can an NRI be a nominee for PPF, NSC or SCSS? Here's what happens to the money after the account holder dies. NRIs can now be nominees for India's small-savings schemes like PPF and NSC, a change from 2023. While they can receive proceeds, repatriation abroad is restricted and subject to FEMA and banking rules, typically requiring crediting to an NRO account first. Understand the nuances before naming an NRI nominee. 10 signs you're poor, no matter how much you earn: Hidden money struggles behind your 'comfortable lifestyle'. A 'comfortable lifestyle' may obscure financial issues. These 10 signs indicate that you're poor, no matter how much you earn. Wife accused husband working abroad of cruelty over son's maintenance; Kerala HC cancelled complaint on this ground. Wife accused husband of not providing basic needs and maintenance for their 16-year-old son while he was working abroad. She had initially filed a complaint with the Judicial Magistrate first class in Changanacherry. The husband won the case in Kerala High Court. Read the article to know how. Value Trap: A low P/E does not always mean a bargain , 8 factors investors should look at before buying. A stock's low valuation may look attractive, but it can sometimes signal deeper problems in the business. Here are eight ways a seemingly cheap stock can remain cheap and what investors should examine before assuming it is undervalued. Quant MF raises IT services exposure, goes underweight on manufacturing: Key takeaways for investors. Quant Mutual Fund has changed its sector positioning by increasing its allocation to IT services in August 2026. The fund house remains positive on select sectors and expects stock-specific opportunities to drive returns as large-cap markets consolidate. Easier job posting for husband and wife at the same place? Railway Board explains spouse-posting rules for employees. The Railway Board has introduced updated regulations aimed at promoting family welfare by facilitating postings for employees with spouses. This initiative allows for couples working within the railways or related government sectors to be stationed together whenever possible. However, the availability of posts and administrative feasibility remain crucial factors influencing these placements. Can one co-owner be taxed alone on property value and stamp duty difference? What ITAT says. The ITAT delivered a significant ruling in the case of a Mumbai taxpayer who, in 2017, purchased a flat jointly with his wife in Chembur. The actual consideration paid for the property was rupees 60 lakh, while its stamp-duty value was rupees 94.8 lakh, creating a gap of around rupees 34.8 lakh. The hidden drag on freelance income: Why your overseas client invoices don't match the money reaching your bank. For Indian freelancers, the invoice value of an overseas client payment may not be the amount that reaches their bank account. FX conversion margins, platform fees and SWIFT costs can reduce the final INR payout. Here is how freelancers can calculate the actual amount they received. SBI ATM rules set to change from October 1, 2026: Free ATM transaction limit for these account holders cut from 10 to 5. Beginning October 1, 2026, State Bank of India will implement a change in its policy regarding free ATM transactions for salary account holders. These customers will be limited to five free withdrawals each month; any transactions beyond that will incur charges. NPS Active versus Auto Choice: Which investment option is right for your retirement goals?. One mistake investors may make is assuming that the option with greater equity exposure is necessarily the best choice, particularly when they are young. PFRDA proposes changes to Point of Presence regulations: What NPS subscribers need to know. PFRDA has proposed changes to the Point of Presence framework that could expand NPS access through more types of entities and a dedicated digital route. The proposals also strengthen oversight of NPS Mitras, subscriber-data confidentiality and PoP accountability for fraud or negligence. Pension delayed? Why retirees in contributory schemes can now take the matter to consumer court. Retirees facing delayed pension payments under contributory schemes may approach consumer courts, following an important NCDRC ruling that recognised pension contributors as consumers and treated unjustified delays as deficiency in service. Buying a house in 7 years? Know the best mutual fund categories, equity-debt mix and de-risking strategy. A seven-year house goal can justify high equity exposure initially, but the portfolio should gradually move towards safer assets as the purchase nears. Experts explain which mutual fund categories may suit the goal, why diversification matters and how to protect the corpus from market volatility. Thinking of guaranteeing a loan? Think again; here's how your credit score could suffer if the borrower defaults. Becoming a loan guarantor creates significant financial and credit obligations for individuals. The guaranteed loan appears on your credit report and affects borrowing capacity. Borrower defaults can negatively impact your credit score and future loan access. Lenders can pursue guarantors directly for the full loan amount. Bank holiday tomorrow, 4 September: Will SBI, HDFC Bank and others remain closed for Janmashtami?. Banks in multiple cities, including Ahmedabad and Chennai, will be closed on September 4 for Janmashtami.
